title: Biblical Commentary on the Books of the Chronicles (Clark's Foreign Theological Library)

verification_log.method: Downloaded the OCR text of the 1872 translation

pp. 488–490: Chronicles keeps the events "according to their order in time" — seeking God in the eighth year (aged sixteen), purging from the twelfth year (begun, not completed, then: "he commenced to cleanse"; cf. v. 33), law book in the eighteenth; p. 504 n.: the LXX addition "in the eighth month" at 2 Kgs 22:3, used by Thenius and Bertheau for autumn-reckoned regnal years, is a "worthless gloss"; pp. 504–505: Necho came "to fight at Carchemish"; "the house of my war" = his hereditary enemy; the God who commanded Necho is the true God, but no special revelation need be supposed
